claim: Atomic step dequeue in SQLite uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE and UPDATE ... WHERE rowid = (SELECT rowid ... LIMIT 1) RETURNING *, preventing concurrent worker deadlocks on single-file SQLite databases.
mechanism: Atomic SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE Step Dequeue
applicabilityConditions: Requires SQLite 3.35+ supporting RETURNING clauses and immediate write transactions.
localContext: Litequeue provides an embedded persistent queue backed by SQLite. Because standard SQLite transactions begin in DEFERRED mode, multiple concurrent readers attempting to write can deadlock with SQLITE_BUSY; BEGIN IMMEDIATE acquires a reserved lock immediately.

sourceProvenance.queryOrCodeSnippet: cursor.execute('BEGIN IMMEDIATE'); cursor.execute('UPDATE _messages SET status = 1, locked_at = ? WHERE rowid = (SELECT rowid FROM _messages WHERE status = 0 LIMIT 1) RETURNING *')
